title: Barry Larkin 1994 Topps Stadium Club #414 Cincinnati Reds SS
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1994 Topps Stadium Club baseball trading card featuring Barry Larkin of the Cincinnati Reds. The card is a standard size and is from the Major League league. It is a non-autographed card with a red parallel/variety. The card number is 414 and it is part of the base set. The manufacturer is Topps. This card is a great addition to any sports trading card collection.
